text: true laws: Heb. laws of truth
which thou hadst sworn to give them: Heb. which thou hadst lift up thine hand to give them
a God ready to pardon: Heb. a god of pardons
as they would: Heb. according to their will
wells: Or, cisterns | fruit trees: Heb. tree of food
they did evil: Heb. they returned to do evil
and withdrew the shoulder: Heb. they gave a withdrawing shoulder
forbear them: Heb. protract over them | in thy Prophets: Heb. in the hand of thy Prophets
trouble: Heb. weariness | that hath come upon us: Heb. that hath found us
seal unto it: Heb. are at the sealing, or sealed
